title: salvia carnosa
intro: Salvia carnosa, commonly known as Red Sage, is a perennial plant belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, with its health benefits including the ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Red Sage are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and neuroprotective properties. The bioactive constituents in Salvia carnosa have been shown to exhibit sedative and anti-anxiety effects, making it a potential natural remedy for stress relief and improved sleep quality.
